key_insight: BoT-GRPO replaces GRPO’s uniform token advantage with length-invariant bag-of-tokens aggregation over token-level rewards, enabling critic-free process supervision that learns faster and achieves better reasoning quality.
engineering_relevance: The method is a drop-in RL upgrade for token-level reward settings, promising faster convergence and higher final performance without the compute and complexity of a value network.
method: Aggregate all token-level rewards across rollouts with inverse-length weighting to prevent long sequences from dominating.
Compute per-token advantages from weighted group statistics instead of assigning the same rollout-level advantage to every token.
Use a critic-free GRPO extension that directly leverages token-level reward models for process supervision.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to 1.9× faster convergence on React code generation, up to 8.1% absolute Pass@k gains on AIME, and improved compile/win rates across multiple base-model families.
watch_item: Performance depends on having clean, bounded, stable token-level rewards; noisier reward signals may reduce gains or stall training.
paper_title: BoT-GRPO: Efficient Process-Reward RL for Reasoning via Bag-of-Token Aggregation
